members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent best describes what the customer wants or is reporting? Pick exactly one.

criteria.activate_my_card: Customer has received their card and asks how to activate it or says activation is not working.
criteria.age_limit: Asks about minimum age to open an account or whether children/teenagers can use the bank.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Asks about using Apple Pay, Google Pay, Android Pay or adding the card to a phone wallet, or top up via Apple Pay / Google Pay.
criteria.atm_support: Asks where ATMs are, which ATMs accept the card, or whether the card can be used at ATMs in general (no specific failed withdrawal).
criteria.automatic_top_up: Asks about auto top-up: how it works, turning it on or off, automatic top-ups that happened.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money transferred INTO the customer's own account (e.g. from their UK account / another bank account) is not showing in their balance yet, the balance is taking long to update after a transfer, or they ask to check that a transfer from their UK account went through; includes 'what's the normal time frame, I just made a transfer and it's not showing up'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited a cheque, cash or 'some money' / 'the money I put into my account' and their balance has not updated / the deposit is not showing yet.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Customer has trouble transferring money to a beneficiary / payee, cannot add one, or a transfer was blocked because the beneficiary is not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made (often sent by mistake or to the wrong account).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; asks how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Asks where the card is accepted, which shops or merchants take it, or why a particular merchant does not accept it in general.
criteria.card_arrival: Customer ordered a physical card and it has not arrived in the mail yet; wants to track the card or says it is late.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Asks how long card delivery takes, delivery options, express delivery, or when to expect a newly ordered card (before it is overdue).
criteria.card_linking: Asks how to link or re-link a card to the app / account, e.g. adding a card they found again or an existing card into the app.
criteria.card_not_working: Physical card is not working in general, stopped working, or is broken/damaged (not specifically contactless, not the virtual card, not one specific declined payment).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Customer was charged a fee for paying by card / making a card purchase and asks why there is a fee on a card payment.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: Customer sees a card payment or purchase they do not recognise or did not make.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Complains that an exchange rate they got was wrong, bad, too high or that they got less than expected, or that something is wrong with an exchange rate charge (default for rate complaints unless it was clearly a cash withdrawal).
criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM kept / swallowed / retained the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Customer was charged a fee for withdrawing cash, or asks about ATM withdrawal fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: The app/statement shows a cash withdrawal or a cash amount the customer did not make or did not actually receive (e.g. 'app shows cash I did not receive'), including when they suspect someone used or copied their card to withdraw cash.
criteria.change_pin: Wants to change or reset the card PIN (not because it is blocked).
criteria.compromised_card: Thinks the card or its details were compromised, hacked, or used by someone else without permission (fraud), when no single specific unrecognised cash withdrawal is the main complaint and the card is not described as lost or stolen.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless / tap payments are not working.
criteria.country_support: Asks which countries the bank or its cards/accounts are available or supported in, or whether they can use the service while living abroad.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment at a shop or online was declined / rejected.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The card would not work at an ATM / an ATM cash withdrawal was declined or refused.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer the customer tried to make was declined / rejected by the bank, or they are told they cannot make the transfer.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Customer sees a direct debit they do not recognise or did not set up.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Asks about limits of disposable virtual cards, e.g. how many times one can be used or how many can be created.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Wants to change personal details such as name, address, phone number, email or other account details.
criteria.exchange_charge: Asks about fees or charges for currency exchange (the fee itself, not the rate), or volume discounts on exchange fees.
criteria.exchange_rate: Neutral information question about what exchange rates are used or how they are determined (no complaint, not about getting cash).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Asks how to exchange or convert money between currencies in the app (the steps / how to do it).
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Sees an unexpected extra charge or small fee on the statement, especially a small amount like £1 / $1 / €1 (even if pending or unrecognised), and asks why they were charged it.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer or large payment (e.g. a mortgage or flat-purchase payment) failed / did not go through / keeps giving an error message / bounced back.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Asks which fiat currencies are supported for holding, exchanging or spending, or whether exchanges to / from a particular currency (e.g. EUR) are allowed or possible.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Wants to get or create a disposable (single-use) virtual card or asks how they work.
criteria.get_physical_card: Asks about the PIN of their card: where to find it, how to get it, PIN not received yet.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Wants an additional / extra / spare card, e.g. a second card or a card for a family member.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Wants to get or order a (non-disposable) virtual card, asks how virtual cards are obtained, or says their virtual card has not come through / they cannot find it.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card has been lost or stolen, the customer cannot find it, or they want to freeze/block their card urgently.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone has been lost or stolen and they worry about app/account access.
criteria.order_physical_card: Wants to get or order a new physical card (including a physical card to use in stores), asks how to get a card, or about the ordering process (costs/fees, design, where they can be delivered).
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode / password or needs to reset the passcode to log in.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase shows as pending, or a payment has 'not gone through yet' / is taking a while to go through.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up shows as pending or is taking a long time to complete.
criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer is shown as pending / still processing / in progress, and the customer asks why it is still pending or how long it will stay pending.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked or locked after too many wrong attempts; wants it unblocked.
criteria.receiving_money: Asks how to receive money or a salary into the account, or about receiving incoming payments.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Customer was promised or expects a refund from a merchant but it is not showing in their account.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request or get a refund for a purchase / asks how to get money back from a merchant.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted / returned / reversed back to the customer and they ask why.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Asks which cards, card brands, payment methods or currencies are accepted / supported for topping up or adding funds.
criteria.terminate_account: Wants to close or delete their account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Asks whether there is a fee for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Asks about the fee for topping up with a card, or was charged for a card top-up.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Asks whether or how they can top up / add money with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, did not work, or the customer thinks something went wrong with the top-up.
criteria.top_up_limits: Asks about limits on top-ups: maximum or minimum amount, how much or how often they can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted / cancelled / returned, or the top-up went through but the money then disappeared or the account was never credited.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Asks how to top up using a card, or about a card top-up that did not show up.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction / payment was charged twice (duplicate charge).
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Was charged a fee for a transfer, or asks about transfer fees.
criteria.transfer_into_account: Asks how to put money into their account, which ways are available to add money, or how to transfer money into their own account from another bank account.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Customer sent / transferred money to someone else or another account (a friend, landlord, retailer's account, within the country) and it has not arrived / 'is not here yet' / not reached that account / not gone through, or the recipient hasn't got it, even if they also ask how long it takes. Use this for 'I transferred money but it is not there yet' when they do not mention their own balance or a transfer into their own account.
criteria.transfer_timing: Asks how long a transfer takes or how much longer they must wait for their transfer (e.g. 'it's been a couple of days, how much longer?'), without saying it is pending and without saying it has not reached the recipient.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Tried to verify identity but it failed or they cannot complete identity verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: Asks how to verify their identity or what documents are needed for verification.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Asks about verifying or proving the source of their funds / where their money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Asks about the verification code / verifying a card used for top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card or a disposable virtual card is not working, or a payment with it was rejected / declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Asks whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, whether they can choose between them, or whether Visa or Mastercard is accepted.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Asks why they need to verify their identity.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave the wrong amount of cash, less than requested, or nothing while still charging them.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Exchange rate when getting cash or at an ATM abroad: a wrong rate on a cash withdrawal, or what rate applies when withdrawing cash.
